description: This Java class 'ConfigurableStatusAndHealthProvider' implements the 'StatusAndHealthProvider' interface, providing configurable status and health retrieval functionalities via injected 'StatusSupplier' and 'StatusHealthSupplier' dependencies.

classes.name: ConfigurableStatusAndHealthProvider
classes.description: Implements a configurable provider for status and health information, using injected suppliers.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Factory method to create a new instance with given status and health suppliers.

methods.name: retrieveStatus
methods.description: Retrieves status as a CompletionStage wrapping a JsonObject.

methods.name: retrieveHealth
methods.description: Retrieves health information as a CompletionStage wrapping a StatusInfo object.
